description: Review the text of legal documents with a professional review workflow. Identify omissions, risks and counterarguments, examine citations, and prepare a review card tied to the current document. Specify the jurisdiction independently of the output language. Supports Spanish, English, Portuguese, French, German and Italian. Source verification and legal conclusions remain subject to professional review; language support does not imply verified coverage of every jurisdiction.
